title: Global incidence, prevalence, years lived with disability (YLDs), disability-adjusted life-years (DALYs), and healthy life expectancy (HALE) for 371 diseases and injuries in 204 countries and territories and 811 subnational locations, 1990-2021: a systematic analysis for the Global Burden of Disease Study 2021.

model.rationale: The generated summary accurately mirrors the original article across all assessed domains: study design (systematic analysis for GBD 2021), population (global, 204 countries, age/sex groups), methods (YLDs, YLLs, DALYs, HALE, modeling, data processing), and results/conclusions (all reported numbers and percentage changes, leading causes, trends, and limitations). No fabricated or unsupported claims were detected; the summary faithfully reproduces key findings and maintains alignment with the reference.
